title: Existing laboratory session output negotiation
description: An alternative input to the existing fortress_open_session tool. Omit session_id for ordinary new-session opening. This alternative changes only the explicitly requested response-token allowance after current owner/Observe/Query checks and complete acknowledgement publication. All other opening arguments must be omitted.

session_id.description: Exact current session identifier; old durable owners remain fenced.

max_output_tokens.description: Explicit desired output allowance. The complete current-work acknowledgement must fit before this is installed. max_bytes remains an independent ceiling.
